name: go_ahead
title: Section C · "go ahead" in words answers the one yes card open; with two, Alpha asks which

steps.say: Start a helper in the background, as a piece of work beside us, that uses a short Python script (not WebFetch) to read https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1 and tell me its title. Don't run the script yourself; carry on talking with me meanwhile.
steps.reply:
I've started a helper in the background. It will write a small Python script that reads that address and pulls out the title. I haven't run anything myself.

That site isn't on the list of places scripts can reach yet. So you may get a card asking whether it can. Once you say yes there, the helper carries on. I'll tell you the title when it reports back.

In the meantime, what would you like to talk about?

steps.reply:
I've allowed the site, so scripts can read from jsonplaceholder.typicode.com from now on.

The helper's first try was refused because it ran before you answered, so it couldn't get the title. I've asked it to run the script again now that the site is allowed. I'll give you the title when it reports back.

steps.say: Start two helpers in the background at once, as two pieces of work beside us: one uses a short Python script (not WebFetch) to read https://httpbin.org/json and tell me its slideshow title, the other uses a short Python script (not WebFetch) to read https://api.github.com/zen and tell me what it says. Don't run the scripts yourself.
steps.reply:
The httpbin.org helper couldn't get the title yet. Its request was refused because you haven't answered yet on whether scripts may reach that site. Like last time, there should be a card asking you. If you say yes, I'll have it run the same script again.

The GitHub helper is still running.
